newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian call money steady in balanced trade.
newsitem.headline: Croatian call money steady in balanced trade.

text.p: Croatian interbank rates plotted a steady course on Monday in balanced trade, money market dealers said.
Fresh interbank kuna demand was moderate thanks to high balances in the banking sector which topped 600 million kuna in total at the weekend.
There was no problem squaring some 38.5 million kuna sought by money market borrowers by 0930 GMT, dealers said.
Call money, granted at a new lower 8.0-percent rate, accounted for the bulk of the fresh trade. One smaller 14-day deal was also struck at a stable 11 percent.

Commercial banks slightly increased their Lombard borrowing from the central bank to 36.3 million kuna. Lombard loans are granted at 9.5 percent for a total of 12 days each month. -- Kolumbina Bencevic, Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075
